name: Swaggy Brand New RUS Build
author: SnobbyCoder60

notes: Start sending ALL to @resource/resource_food.webp@@resource/sheep.webp@ + queue 2x @unit_worker/villager.webp@ ( + scout around base @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@)

Send 2x @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @abilities/repair.webp@@building_rus/hunting-cabin.webp@ each one (the influence of the two areas MUST NOT overlap) + 1x @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/house.webp@
Retrieve the @resource/sheep.webp@ to the @building_economy/town-center.webp@ with the @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@

Leave 4x @unit_worker/villager.webp@@resource/resource_food.webp@ and move ALL to @resource/resource_wood.webp@+@resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_wood.webp@ (up to 8). IMPORTANT: let @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ gather ALL the 3x @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ around  @building_economy/town-center.webp@

As soon as the 3x @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ are gathered move 7x @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@and @abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ with the remaining @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ UNDER the @landmark_rus/kremlin.webp@ area of influence

@abilities/repair.webp@@building_rus/hunting-cabin.webp@ on @resource/deer.webp@ near the @landmark_rus/kremlin.webp@ with the 5x @age/age_2.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ and gather @resource/deer.webp@

Leave on @resource/resource_food.webp@ only the 5x @resource/deer.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ and 1-2x @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@, then move ALL @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ + get @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@ and @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@
IMMEDIATELY prod. @unit_rus/warrior-monk.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@@resource/relics.webp@ (starting from the FURTHEST ones)
Build @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@+ 3x@building_military/archery-range.webp@ (see notes to understand which units to produce accordingly)

Move 8x@resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @abilities/repair.webp@@building_rus/hunting-cabin.webp@ on a new @resource/resource_food.webp@ source (can be @resource/deer.webp@ or @resource/berrybush.webp@)

Leave 10-15x @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_food.webp@ + get ALL @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ UPGRADES + ALL @landmark_rus/abbey-of-the-trinity.webp@ UPGRADES + ALL ECONOMIC UPGRADES
Move all @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@ whenever gathered 3 or MORE @resource/relics.webp@

This is a resume to understand better the new build order for RUS by Swaggy Professor.
